name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with a 1px outer shadow. This meets WCAG AAA for focus visibility while ensuring keyboard users can track focus reliably. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings that may feel heavier in dense interfaces, but clarity outweighs minimal visual weight.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 7:1 still blurs on high-DPI screens—users lose the edge. A 2px ring at 4.5:1 with a 0.5px glow keeps sharpness without sacrificing too much contrast. Test both on a 4K screen at 200% zoom; if the 2px version holds, adopt it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 0.5px outer glow. It stays razor-sharp on high-DPI screens and 200% zoom, which keyboard users rely on to see focus instantly. The trade-off is slightly lower contrast than AAA, but 4.5:1 still meets WCAG AA and keeps edges crisp where 3px rings blur. Clarity on every device beats a perfect score we can’t see.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring at 4.5:1 risks failing users who need *both* high contrast *and* sharp edges—like those with low vision or glare sensitivity. A 2.5px ring at 6:1 with a 0.3px glow keeps crispness *and* AA compliance; test it on a 4K screen at 200% zoom with a screen reader.
